# overwrite transform for centered stamp
new='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    # take compact seed, excluding isolated marker-color points
    counts={}
    for r,c,v in pts: counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
    marker=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    seeds=[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in pts if v!=marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c,v in seeds); r1=max(r for r,c,v in seeds); c0=min(c for r,c,v in seeds); c1=max(c for r,c,v in seeds)
    seed=[(r-r0,c-c0,v) for r,c,v in seeds]
    ar=(r1-r0)//2; ac=(c1-c0)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in [(r,c) for r,c,v in pts if v==marker]:
        out[r][c]=bg
        for dr,dc,v in seed:
            y=r+dr-ar; x=c+dc-ac
            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w: out[y][x]=v
    return out
'''
